Subject: Exhibitor Application Inquiry — GEGYjiji / Watercolor Artist

Dear Tokyo Art Book Fair team,

TABF has established itself as one of the most serious platforms in Asia for artists whose work lives at the intersection of image-making and the printed page, and it is in that spirit that I am writing to ask about the exhibitor application process for the next edition. I am GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, and since 2020 I have maintained a daily watercolor practice — a series called "diary" — that documents the utterly ordinary: red walls, alleyways, pools, green ponds, the particular quality of light in a familiar street corner. That practice led directly to my first solo illustration collection, Colour Diary, published in October 2021, which I believe would sit naturally within the kind of intimate, image-led publishing that TABF tends to gather. You can find a continuous record of the work on my Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/gegyjiji/. I would be grateful if you could share details on the application timeline, booth formats available, and any associated fees.

GEGYjiji

Subject: Consignment Inquiry — Colour Diary / GEGYjiji

Dear B&B team,

I have long admired how your shelves bring together books, zines, and art in a way that feels genuinely curated rather than simply stocked, and Shimokitazawa feels like the right neighborhood for the kind of quiet, observational work I make. I am GEGYjiji, a Tokyo-based Chinese watercolor artist, and I am writing to ask whether B&B accepts consignment inquiries for self-published artist books. My first illustration collection, Colour Diary, grew out of a daily watercolor diary practice I began in 2020 — it documents domestic interiors, neighborhood light, and small moments of urban life in a format I think would sit naturally alongside the books you carry. You can find a fuller sense of my work on Instagram at @gegyjiji. I would love to hear about your current process for consignment, and I am also happy to visit the shop in person if that would be easier.

Warm regards,
GEGYjiji

Subject: Application for START Box Studio Space — GEGYjiji (Watercolor Illustrator)

Dear START Box ササハタハツ / 白鬚 Team,

I am writing to apply for studio space through the 2026年度利用者募集 program, drawn to START Box's commitment to supporting emerging artists working at the intersection of daily practice and place-based observation. My name is GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor illustrator based in Tokyo, and my work — including my first illustration collection Colour Diary, which grew from a daily watercolor diary practice I have maintained since 2020 — focuses on the quiet atmospheres of Tokyo neighborhoods, domestic interiors, and the particular quality of urban light as seen through a cross-cultural lens. In February 2023, I participated in the group exhibition Tide from China Part1 at ACG_Labo in Harajuku, my first exhibition in Japan, alongside five other Chinese illustrators. I believe dedicated studio space within a community rooted in Tokyo's local art ecology would meaningfully support the next phase of my practice, particularly as I develop new work and exhibition relationships in the city. A portfolio of my watercolor illustration work is available on Instagram at @gegyjiji, and I would welcome the opportunity to share further materials or speak with your team at your convenience.

GEGYjiji

exploration_layer.why_this_fits_short: SPBS curates art and design publications for a discerning Shibuya-adjacent audience — ideal for GEGYjiji's Tokyo urban watercolor prints and zines. Consignment here builds quiet, sustained visibility among design professionals.
exploration_layer.quick_action: Visit the Honten (main store in Tomigaya) and speak with staff about consignment or exhibition. Bring physical samples.
exploration_layer.relationship_note: Approach in person at the Tomigaya Honten. Bring a sample zine or print portfolio. SPBS has a strong curatorial eye — pitch the Tokyo urban watercolor angle clearly. Also runs an online platform for digital consignment.

exploration_layer.one_sentence_zh: 富ヶ谷首屈一指的设计与艺术书店，拥有成熟的寄售文化，是GEGYjiji印刷作品进入东京设计圈的天然切入点。
exploration_layer.why_it_fits_zh: SPBS为毗邻涩谷的挑剔受众精选艺术与设计出版物，非常适合GEGYjiji的东京城市水彩版画与独立刊物。在此寄售可在设计从业者中积累稳定而持续的知名度。
exploration_layer.one_sentence_ja: 富ヶ谷を拠点とするデザイン・アート書店で、委託販売文化が根付いており、GEGYjijiの印刷物を東京デザインコミュニティへ届ける自然な入口となります。
exploration_layer.why_it_fits_ja: SPBSは渋谷周辺の目の肥えた読者向けにアート・デザイン出版物をキュレーションしており、GEGYjijiの東京都市水彩プリントやZINEに最適です。ここでの委託販売はデザインのプロフェッショナルへの静かで持続的な露出につながります。
